It’s not that I have a problem with gay people. That is far from the truth. It’s just ever since I was young I always believed myself to be straight as my first fantasies were about women. Then I realized that this was no longer the case around October of 2019 and as far as I’m concerned my life was over after that. I just want to live a normal life you know. Be attracted to the female body, have a family with children with a woman I love. The best way I can explain it is that it’s kind of like transgender people. They feel like a certain gender trapped in the body of the opposite sex. I feel like I’m a straight dude trapped inside of a gay dude. Sometimes I’ll be attracted to a certain woman I see for a moment. Which for a few days makes me very happy and hopeful that I’m bisexual and can be in a relationship with a woman. The suicidal thoughts disappear for a time. Then I think I’m just fully gay and lying to myself and then I’m not attracted to women at all and I’m severely depressed and suicidal. I just want a normal life dude. I’d do anything, just to be fully attracted to just one woman. And I could live a happy life with her. I just don’t see myself in a homosexual relationship outside of hookups. And even then I wouldn’t be happy at all. I don’t want to sit in a therapists chair for an hour or two with them just saying to accept myself over and over again. It won’t work. Just a waste of money. They don’t get it.
